php does not refuse these programs. `zval_undefined_cv` (php-src `Zend/zend_execute.c:280`)
raises `E_WARNING` and returns `&EG(uninitialized_zval)`, so the read IS null and execution
continues. elephc refused them at compile time, and — when a call site resolved the enclosing
function's signature early and dropped the body's diagnostic — miscompiled `return "a" . $nope;`
into a read of uninitialized stack that SEGFAULTED.

Whether a read is undefined is a flow-sensitive question, so the warning is raised by EI
